notes.title: First words
notes.content:
Where to start my first post ...

I am a solo indie developer and have been making this game for about six months.
This is not my first project. As I checked, I have more than 35 projects at various stages of completion, and this is the first completed and published here.

Finally, the release date is approaching. Remains not much -- i should finish the last level, add some effects and sweep`n`clean various little things.

I really hope you enjoy it. It will affect on how soon I can complete the next project.

Thank you subscribers! 



Alexey.
